key_path: zero-account option: `netlify deploy --allow-anonymous` gives a live URL with no account; human claims within 1 hour (`netlify claim` / claim link)
for a credential: `netlify login --request "<agent> wants to login"` prints a login URL for the human plus a URL the agent polls; human signs up or signs in (GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket/email)
if signup was by email: verify email
CLI token is usable as NETLIFY_AUTH_TOKEN. Long-lived PAT: User settings > Applications > Personal access tokens
MCP: `npx -y add-mcp https://netlify-mcp.netlify.app/mcp` then OAuth in browser
human_gates: captcha (reCAPTCHA referenced on the app.netlify.com/signup page)

agent_native_auth.cli_device_flow: yes: `netlify login` (browser ticket flow) and the agent-specific `netlify login --request` mode, which returns a human URL plus a polling URL for the agent
agent_native_auth.provisioning_api_mints_keys: no documented public API to mint PATs. OAuth apps can obtain tokens
agent_native_auth.scoped_tokens: limited: PATs are user-wide with optional expiry
agent_native_auth.claimable_anonymous: yes: `netlify deploy --allow-anonymous` (changelog 2026-03-27). Project is live immediately, claimable within 1 hour via `netlify claim` (site id + drop token). netlify.ai FAQ: 'Agents can build and deploy static sites without needing a Netlify account'

remote.auth: OAuth with DCR (scopes offline_access, read, write)

mcp.type: product (create projects, deploy, env vars, team mgmt via API+CLI)
mcp.one_click: Cursor, VS Code, VS Code Insiders, LM Studio buttons; `npx add-mcp`; Claude and ChatGPT connector/app listings

docs_for_agents.markdown_pages: yes: append .md to any docs URL
docs_for_agents.use_with_ai_page: https://netlify.ai is an agent-directed instruction page ('fetch https://netlify.ai'); docs Build with AI > Agent setup guides per agent

autonomy_note: Fully autonomous for an anonymous deploy (no credential needed). A permanent credential takes about 4 minutes with one human browser approval.
score_justification: Anonymous deploy plus claim, a CLI login mode built for agents, DCR remote MCP and netlify.ai agent instructions. Gaps are no llms-full and coarse, user-wide PATs.
best_practice: `netlify login --request`: the agent gets a URL to hand the human and a URL to poll, so login works even when the agent is not on the user's machine
biggest_gap: Anonymous mode covers deploys only (claim window just 1 hour); no scoped or fine-grained tokens and no API to mint them
